# VirtualTimeline { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline(
    map,
    timeline,
    length,
    *,
    id=None,
    _minted=False,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    through=None,
    name=None,
)
```

The statement that a map was applied to a timeline, giving a timeline.

A virtual timeline exists only by applying the map: it has an ID, a
unit, a number type and a length of its own, and nothing else of it is
written. It holds no events, no children and no flow control. Its
positions and those of the timeline it comes from convert through the
map, in both directions (:meth:`unfold`, :meth:`fold`).

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name     | Type                                        | Description                                                                                                   |
|----------|---------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| map      | [str](`str`)                                | The ID of the map applied: a FlowMap, or a conversion map.                                                    |
| timeline | [str](`str`)                                | The ID of the timeline the map is applied to, or of another virtual timeline.                                 |
| length   | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | The end of the virtual timeline on its own axis, which states its unit and number type too.                   |
| through  | [str](`str`) \| None                        | The ID of the group or conversion map that carries the map to ``timeline``; kept as read and never evaluated. |
| name     | [str](`str`) \| None                        | Optional display name.                                                                                        |
| id       | [str](`str`)                                | The virtual timeline's ID; minted in the ID kind of its unit (``clt_{N}`` on quarters), as a timeline's is.   |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.timelines import ContinuousLogicalTimeline
>>> score = ContinuousLogicalTimeline(length=24, uid="score")
>>> a = score.create_region(0, 16, id="a")
>>> b = score.create_region(16, 24, id="b")
>>> played = score.create_virtual_timeline(score.create_flow_map([a, a, b]))
>>> played.id, played.length
('clt_1', Coordinate(Fraction(40, 1), quarters))
>>> played.unfold(4, score)
[Coordinate(Fraction(4, 1), quarters), Coordinate(Fraction(20, 1), quarters)]
>>> played.fold(20, score)
Coordinate(Fraction(4, 1), quarters)
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [fold](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.fold) | Return the root position played at a position of this virtual timeline. |
| [from_dict](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_dict) | Restore a virtual timeline from its object in ``virtual_timelines``. |
| [from_flow_map](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_flow_map) | State that *flow_map* was applied to its root timeline. |
| [resolve](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.resolve) | Return the played order this virtual timeline is the axis of. |
| [unfold](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.unfold) | Return every position of this virtual timeline a root position is played at. |

### fold { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.fold }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.fold(coordinate, root)
```

Return the root position played at a position of this virtual timeline.

See :meth:`ResolvedFlowMap.fold`.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                    | Description                                                                                                              | Default    |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| coordinate | [CoordinateInput](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.CoordinateInput`) | A position on this virtual timeline's axis: a bare value, a Coordinate, or an IdCoordinate naming this virtual timeline. | _required_ |
| root       | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)                       | The root timeline holding the virtual timeline.                                                                          | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                                            |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) \| None | The position on the root's axis, or None inside a gap. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                        |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | As :meth:`resolve` and :meth:`ResolvedFlowMap.fold`, or if an IdCoordinate names another timeline. |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_dict }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_dict(data)
```

Restore a virtual timeline from its object in ``virtual_timelines``.

IDs are bare. ``length`` is a bare value read as ``number_type``
decides; ``through`` and ``name`` may be left out. Keys the library
does not know are kept and written back.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                  | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------|------------|
| data   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | The virtual timeline object. | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                     |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the object is malformed or its length is represented otherwise than its number type selects. |

### from_flow_map { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_flow_map }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_flow_map(flow_map, root, *, id=None, name=None)
```

State that *flow_map* was applied to its root timeline.

The length is the FlowMap's virtual length, the unit and number type
are the root's.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                    | Description                                  | Default    |
|----------|---------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|------------|
| flow_map | [FlowMap](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.FlowMap`) | The FlowMap applied.                         | _required_ |
| root     | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)       | The root timeline it names.                  | _required_ |
| id       | [str](`str`) \| None                                    | The virtual timeline's ID; minted when None. | `None`     |
| name     | [str](`str`) \| None                                    | Optional display name.                       | `None`     |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                             |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the FlowMap cannot be read against *root* (:meth:`FlowMap.resolve`). |

### resolve { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.resolve }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.resolve(root)
```

Return the played order this virtual timeline is the axis of.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                              | Description                                     | Default    |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| root   | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`) | The root timeline holding the virtual timeline. | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the virtual timeline is not the FlowMap of *root* applied to *root*: it applies another map (a conversion map), is applied to another timeline, or goes ``through`` a group or conversion map. Such a statement is kept and written back, but its positions are not converted. |

### unfold { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.unfold }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.unfold(coordinate, root)
```

Return every position of this virtual timeline a root position is played at.

See :meth:`ResolvedFlowMap.unfold`.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                    | Description                                     | Default    |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| coordinate | [CoordinateInput](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.CoordinateInput`) | A position on the root's axis.                  | _required_ |
| root       | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)                       | The root timeline holding the virtual timeline. | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                            |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | As :meth:`resolve` and :meth:`ResolvedFlowMap.unfold`. |
